## Installation & Setup

```bash
# macOS (Homebrew)
brew install <tool>

# Linux / WSL (Package Manager or Cargo)
sudo apt install <tool>
# or
cargo install <tool>

# Windows (Winget / Scoop)
winget install <tool>
```
